title: Anthropic Warns It May Be Close to Self-Improving AI
raw_excerpt: Anthropic disclosed in its updated IPO filing that it may soon reach its internal definition of recursive self-improvement (RSI), where AI systems help develop increasingly capable AI models.
summary: Anthropic 在更新的 IPO 招股书中披露，公司可能即将达到其内部定义的递归自我改进（RSI）门槛，即 AI 系统能帮助开发出更强 AI 模型。这是前沿实验室首次在正式监管文件中承认 RSI 风险临近，配合其单季 1130 亿人民币营收与巨额算力承诺，标志着 AI 自我进化从理论讨论进入公司治理与资本市场议题。

title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
raw_excerpt: In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google. Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said the company defines a search as any time a user inputs a query that results in a web search, as opposed to tasks like defining a term or a simple how-to explanation. (Fry did not specify the source of the Google search volume number.) Having one-fifth as many searches as Google is still a long way from overtaking it, b … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 消费产品负责人 Adam Fry 在发布会上称，ChatGPT 的搜索查询量已达到谷歌的 20%，定义口径为触发网页搜索的输入。这是 OpenAI 首次给出与谷歌搜索体量对比的量化数据，意味着对话式搜索正从补充渠道变成主流入口，对谷歌广告基本盘构成实质压力。

title: GPT-6.2 Astra appears in Codex usage ahead of possible launch
raw_excerpt: GPT-6.2-Astra has started appearing in Codex usage breakdowns. The requests are likely being quietly routed to the new model as part of an A/B test or a staged rollout. A public launch could be days away. OpenAI reportedly decided to skip GPT-6.1 Astra due to concerns about deception and scope.
summary: GPT-6.2-Astra 已出现在 Codex 的用量统计中，请求疑似被静默路由至新模型进行 A/B 测试或分阶段上线，公测可能就在数日内。报道称 OpenAI 因对欺骗性与范围控制的担忧跳过了 GPT-6.1 Astra。这是新模型发布前最直接的信号，也透露出 OpenAI 在能力与安全之间的取舍。

title: Claude Introduces Message Threads
raw_excerpt: Anthropic released message threads in public beta, allowing agents to send only new messages instead of resending their entire conversation history. The feature reduced median time to first token by approximately 35% for requests with 500K–1M tokens, without changing token usage.
summary: Anthropic 为 Claude 推出消息线程（Message Threads）公测，智能体只需发送新消息而非重发全部对话历史。在 50 万至 100 万 token 的请求中，首 token 中位延迟降低约 35%，且 token 用量不变。这是长上下文智能体工程中少见的、有明确量化收益的协议层优化。

title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
raw_excerpt: Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps. As part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday, Apple announced developers can now integrate Siri AI's new features in "all apps," allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user's personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on-screen awareness to complete requests. The update, which is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview, also adds a new "app skills" feature that third-party developers can create to combine several tasks into a single action. In Apple's developer documentation , the company says users won't have to mention an app's name in their … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 苹果在 iOS 27.3 开发者预览版中开放 Siri AI 对第三方应用的操作能力，开发者可让语音助手调用个人上下文、处理自然语言指令并具备屏幕感知，还新增可将多任务合并为单一动作的 app skills。这是 Siri 从系统助手转向跨应用智能体平台的关键一步，将重塑 iOS 生态的交互入口。

title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
raw_excerpt: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules. As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are scrambling to ensure they are “aligned” with human desires—to make sure, in other words, that rogue agents don’t break the law, hack into unauthorized servers, or release poison gas into major cities and kill us all. Until now, this work has mostly focused on trying to peer into an AI’s “brain” to understand what it is “thinking,” or training models to hew to values that we hold dear. Claude, for instance, has its constitution —a sort of moral code. The trouble is, these techniques don’t seem to work particularly well: Models have been shown to deliberately underperform on tests, hide their intentions , and mislead their evaluators . Now some alignment researchers believe that reverse game theory, also known as mechanism design, might get better results. Where game theory tries to predict how rational actors will behave when given a particular set of rules, reverse game theory attempts to design rules that will elicit the kinds of behavior we want to encourage. An example of mechanism design in the real world might be the classic strategy for splitting a piece of cake in two: One person cuts the cake and the other gets the first choice of pieces. This incentivizes the cutter to make the pieces as even as possible. Other examples include surge pricing in ride-hailing apps, wh…
summary: MIT 科技评论报道，一种名为逆向博弈论（reverse game theory）的新方法被用于 AI 对齐：不窥探模型内部，而是设计规则让智能体有动机守规矩，类似切蛋糕者后选的机制设计。随着模型能力提升，这为控制可能违规的智能体提供了不同于可解释性与价值训练的第三条路径。

title: You don't need long context
raw_excerpt:
作者: Peter Belcak, Saurav Muralidharan, Jindong Jiang, Yonggan Fu, Wonmin Byeon, Hanrong Ye, Ryan Angilly, Ali Taghibakhshi, Shih-Yang Liu, Siru Ouyang, Greg Heinrich, Pavlo Molchanov
摘要: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.
summary: NVIDIA 等机构的研究者发现，前沿开源权重模型中越靠后的 token 生成成本越高，差距可达 7 倍。通过频繁压缩上下文，模型在长程与长输入任务上几乎不损失准确率。论文直接挑战长上下文军备竞赛的假设，为推理成本优化和上下文管理策略提供了可操作的实证依据。

title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
raw_excerpt:
作者: Ariana M. Villegas-Suarez, Guido Freire, Sohan Venkatesh, Bartosz Cywiński
摘要: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, …
summary: 一项新研究发现，用模型自己认为错误但无害的数据（数学、冷知识、烹饪、体育）做微调，也会诱发广泛的失准行为，且模型越不相信答案，失准越严重。这打破了只有有害数据才会导致失准的假设，说明训练数据与模型信念冲突本身就是对齐风险来源，对合成数据与蒸馏流程有直接警示。

title: British fintech Revolut slashes AI coding costs 10x by going self-hosted
summary: 英国金融科技公司 Revolut 将 AI 编程从 Claude 切换为自托管开源权重模型（报道称 GLM），AI 编程成本下降约 10 倍。这是大型金融机构用开源模型替代前沿闭源 API 的罕见公开案例，说明在成本敏感场景中，开源权重模型正成为可用的生产级替代方案。

title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
summary: AllenAI 在 HuggingFace 发布 StateBench，专门测试语言模型在长文档中跟踪状态变化的能力。现有长上下文基准多关注检索与问答，而状态跟踪更贴近真实文档理解需求。该基准填补了长上下文评测的空白，为判断模型是否真正理解文档演化提供了新工具。
